verses.1: I am the proud one who saw the poor in their miserable condition.
verses.2: I drove forward, and it became dark and silent.
verses.3: But in me, his hand will always be turned towards me.
verses.4: In my lips and in my mouth, my secrets are revealed.
verses.5: He built me up, and I rose to my feet.
verses.6: In their thoughts, they keep me captive like a dead body forever.
verses.7: He has mocked me, and I cannot find any way to defend myself against him.
verses.8: Even though I cry and wail, your prayers still have power.
verses.9: I have changed my path in dire ways.
verses.10: He walks around me in secret.
verses.11: His ways are cruel, and he has opened my eyes to see clearly.
verses.12: His path was difficult, but he set me up as a ladder to climb up.
verses.13: He brought with him the sons of Aspaht.
verses.14: I would play music for all nations, every day.
verses.15: Help me in the midst of difficulties; guide me along the right path.
verses.16: And he settled in the land of Shinar. He built his city there.
verses.17: And my soul was abandoned by its master; it was in a state of wretchedness.
verses.18: And he said, “I am forever lost; I begin my journey from Jehovah.”
verses.19: Remember my sorrows and my hardships.
verses.20: Remember, and remember also; may my soul be comforted.
verses.21: This is what I commit to my heart.
verses.22: The mercy of Jehovah, for they did not stop, because His compassion was not shown to them.
verses.23: For those who are new to this, your truth is truly great.
verses.24: The parts of Jehovah said, “My soul shall be placed upon him.”
verses.25: May the Lord be good to Kovu, and may he guide us.
verses.26: May they be good and righteous, and may their names be blessed by Jehovah.
verses.27: It is good for the shepherd to carry his lambs on his shoulders.
verses.28: He sits alone and suffers because he has been taken away from him.
verses.29: It will be given in the form of a gift, but there will still be a request.
verses.30: He will give him life, and he will be rejoiced in his humiliation.
verses.31: For he will not abandon his Lord forever.
verses.32: For he is merciful and full of his kindness.
verses.33: For he did not resist from his heart, and the sons of man were destroyed.
verses.34: To bring under his feet all the prisoners of the earth.
verses.36: To avenge a man in a quarrel, Adonai did not see it.
verses.37: Who said this? And Adonai did not command it.
verses.38: From his mouth shall not come either evil or good.
verses.39: What does a living person desire more than his own sins?
verses.40: We shall seek our paths again, and they will be discovered. Then we will return to Jehovah.
verses.41: It was carried before our eyes, above the heavens.
verses.42: We have sinned and wronged others. You, however, did not forgive us.
verses.43: They rushed at us with their swords; they attacked us without hesitation. You killed them, but you didn’t spare them at all.
verses.44: May the heavens cry out to you from afar, from the depths of heaven.
verses.45: Sachi and Mamos will place us among the nations.
verses.46: Their mouths have spoken all our evils against us.
verses.47: Fear and dread were our companions throughout our journey.
verses.48: The tears of water rolled down from my eyes, as I looked at the daughter of my people.
verses.49: My eyes were closed, and I couldn’t see from where the light came from.
verses.50: Until He looks down from heaven and sees.
verses.51: My eyes are blurred with tears for all the daughters of this city.
verses.52: My enemy is like a spider that spins its webs to trap others.
verses.53: They were buried in the grave of their lives. Their hands were tied to the stones.
verses.54: I said, “The waters cover my head; I am trapped.”
verses.55: I have heard your name, O LORD, from beneath my feet.
verses.56: Your voice I have heard; may your ears never be silent to my cries for help.
verses.57: You came on the day I called out to you. You said, “Do not be afraid.”
verses.58: Grace, Adonai, you have reconciled my soul. You have saved my life.
verses.59: The LORD saw my suffering and judged it according to His laws.
verses.60: You have seen all their schemes and all their thoughts.
verses.61: You have heard the disgrace they deserve, O LORD, for all their wicked plans.
verses.62: My lips are closed, and they remain sealed upon me every day.
verses.63: When they sat down and stood up, I watched them play music.
verses.64: May the Lord restore them to their rightful place, as they deserve.
verses.65: Give them your protection and shelter from their evil deeds.
verses.66: He will destroy them with his arrows, and he will wipe them out from under the eyes of Jehovah.
